subject: AP billing integration and sender flow for Greenline Corp
messages:
From: Aya Nakamura <aya.n@greenline.co.jp>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greenline AP Team <ap@greenline.co.jp>
Date: Sat, 16 Jun 2028 12:05:00 +0900
Subject: Billing flow + signed invoice requirement

Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking this. A couple of clarifying items from Greenline AP before we proceed with onboarding:

- Delivery: We prefer automated SFTP drop for bulk invoices, but can accept emailed PDF copies during initial onboarding.
- File naming: filename must include our entity code (e.g., GL-JP-invoice_YYYYMMDD.pdf).
- Tax/VAT: Invoice must show our tax registration number (JP-123456789) and the billing entity name.
- Separate invoices: We operate multiple entities in APAC and need separate invoices per legal entity when billing_entity is different.
- Signed PDF: Our internal auditors require a digitally signed PDF during the first 3 months. Is that something you support?

Can you confirm which delivery options Redwood supports and whether you can provide a sample invoice (PDF + XML) so our ERP team can validate mapping?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we aim to go live with the first invoice on 2028-06-25.

Best,
Aya Nakamura
Senior AP Manager
Greenline Corp

--
Attachment: (none)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aya Nakamura <aya.n@greenline.co.jp>
Cc: Greenline AP Team <ap@greenline.co.jp>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 16 Jun 2028 17:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing flow + signed invoice requirement

Hi Aya — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes — we can support all three delivery modes you mentioned (portal push / SFTP / email PDF) and we can produce a UBL/XML sample plus a digitally signed PDF for the onboarding window.

Recommended approach (from a reliability + audit trail perspective):
- Primary: Redwood Console e-invoice portal (preferred) with AP email copies to ap@greenline.co.jp
- Secondary: SFTP drop to a client-owned bucket for bulk ingestion (we can push UBL/XML + PDF)
- Tertiary: Email PDF copies to ap@greenline.co.jp during early onboarding or if SFTP is delayed

We can also generate per-entity invoices if you provide the billing_entity code per subscription — that will produce separate invoice numbers and tax lines. We will include the Tax ID field on the PDF and in the XML meta.

I'll attach our AP delivery options doc and a short SFTP onboarding checklist. To move forward I need:
- Final AP contact for SFTP credentials (username@greenline or sftp drop location)
- Confirm whether you want signed PDFs permanently, or only for the first 3 months (signed PDFs have a minor time-to-deliver increase due to signing step)
- If multiple billing entities, please send the mapping (subscription id -> billing_entity code)

I'll loop in our billing ops to confirm any edge cases for Japan VAT.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

--
Attachments: redwood-ap-choices.pdf (pdf), sftp-onboarding-checklist.docx (docx)

Subject: Fwd: Billing flow + signed invoice requirement — need VAT evidence + signing plan

Laura / Vivek — forwarding Greenline's ask. Key points for our ops + tax checklist:

Quoted:
>
> - Delivery: We prefer automated SFTP drop for bulk invoices, but can accept emailed PDF copies during initial onboarding.
> - File naming: filename must include our entity code (e.g., GL-JP-invoice_YYYYMMDD.pdf).
> - Tax/VAT: Invoice must show our tax registration number (JP-123456789) and the billing entity name.
> - Separate invoices: We operate multiple entities in APAC and need separate invoices per legal entity when billing_entity is different.
> - Signed PDF: Our internal auditors require a digitally signed PDF during the first 3 months.
>
Proposed internal plan: enable portal + create SFTP feed (as fallback/primary for bulk), produce separate invoice numbers per billing_entity, and populate Tax ID field in both PDF and XML. We can provision digitally signed PDFs for the first 90 days — does that align with our policy for signed artifacts? Also: for Japan, confirm whether we need additional VAT evidence (e.g., tax invoices with registrant certificate attached) or if Tax ID on invoice suffices.

Can you confirm:
1) Whether signed PDFs are allowed as an onboarding-only artifact (90 days);
2) Any additional metadata Greenline will require in the UBL XML (we have a sample but need to add extra fields if required);
3) If we should route this through our APAC dedicated billing region (yes/no).

If you'd prefer, we can run a quick 30-min handoff with Greenline and our SRE to collect SFTP details.

Thanks —
Ben

Subject: Re: Billing flow + signed invoice requirement

Hi Ben — thanks, that plan works. A few specifics to confirm from Greenline side:

- AP contact for onboarding: Satoshi Ito <s.ito@greenline.co.jp> (please send SFTP details to him).
- Tax ID (Japan): JP-123456789 (please show on invoice header).
- Billing entities: GL-JP (Japan entity) and GL-AP (regional consolidation). We need separate invoices when GL-JP is billed vs GL-AP.
- Signed PDFs: OK to be onboarding-only for 90 days.
- XML format: our ERP expects UBL 2.1 with the <AccountingSupplierParty> and <TaxScheme> fields present. Please provide a sample XML.

We can provide SFTP account details once you send the expected filename schema and example payload. Do you have a sample XML and a copy of the signed PDF so our ERP and audit teams can validate?

Regards,
Aya

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Billing flow + signed invoice requirement — next steps and sample files

Hi Aya / Satoshi — great, thanks for the details. Next steps and what we are delivering this week: 

1) Delivery plan: enable e-invoice portal and configure e-mail copy to ap@greenline.co.jp. We will provision an SFTP drop (Redwood -> your SFTP) for bulk UBL/XML + PDF files.

2) Samples: attached a sample UBL 2.1 XML (sample-einvoice-ubl.xml) and a signed PDF example (redwood-signed-sample.pdf). The XML includes <AccountingSupplierParty> and <TaxScheme> fields as requested. You can also download a zipped sample set here: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/greenline-einvoice-sample

3) Filename schema: GL-{ENTITY}-invoice_{YYYYMMDD}_{INVNUM}.(xml|pdf). Example: GL-JP-invoice_20280625_INV-000123.pdf

4) Billing entities: we will generate separate invoices per "billing_entity". Please supply mapping (subscription id -> GL-JP or GL-AP) by EOD 2028-06-19 to hit your go-live date.

5) Signing: we will enable signed PDFs for the first 90 days; expect an additional ~30s processing time per invoice for signing.

6) SFTP provisioning: please either (A) provide a write-only account for redwood-sftp@greenline with an sftp hostname and username, or (B) nominate a contact window for a short call to exchange credentials.

I'll have our billing ops (Laura) follow up to confirm region routing and final metadata fields for Japan VAT. 

Thanks — looking forward to the handoff.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132
